title: PublicProvidersRegistry
description: RFC-0003 — a signed directory of Glyph providers, distributable as a single JSON file.

registryVersion.description: Wire version of the registry format.

registryId.description: Opaque identifier of who issued this registry. Not a globally-unique name.

issuedAt.description: When this registry document was signed.

ttlSeconds.description: How long the client may cache before re-fetching.

publicKey.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 public key of the signer.

fingerprint.description: sha-256 fingerprint of the signer public key.

signature.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 signature over the canonical hash of every other field.

name.description: Stable human-friendly identifier for this provider in the registry.

endpoint.description: HTTPS base URL of the Glyph server. The consumer connects here.

publicKey.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 public key the provider signs cards/receipts with.

intent.description: One-line description of what this provider is for.

conformanceBadge.description: URL of the shields.io endpoint JSON for this provider.

lastVerifiedAt.description: When the registry maintainers last re-verified this entry.
